\par Summary:\b0   The legislation establishes Bike Boulevards on the segment of Mountain Road between the Bosque Trail and Woodward Avenue (the street the Embassy Suites at I-25 is located) and on Silver Avenue between the Bosque Trail and Second Street.   A bike boulevard is a package of changes that transforms a residential street into a "bike expressway" which accommodates local motor traffic. As an example below are the Programming Guide and Tool Box Package used by the City of Berkeley, California.
\par 
\par \pard\qc\b\f1 Berkeley California: Bike Boulevard Programming Procedure\f0 .
\par \pard

\intbl   1 .      Create the look and feel of a bicycle boulevard.\cell 1.      Look and feel\cell\row
\intbl   2.      Slow traffic and discourage diversion of traffic to the bike boulevard when unwarranted STOP signs are removed.  Unwarranted STOP signs cause excessive stopping and delay for bicyclists.  They also increase noise and air pollution, increase fuel consumption and non-compliance compromises safety for all.  They often increase speeds mid-block as well.\cell 2.      Traffic Calming\cell\row
\intbl    3.      Address school or pedestrian related safety issues.\cell 3.      Ped Safety\cell\row
\intbl    4.      Help bicyclists cross major streets.\cell 4.      Help Crossing\cell\row
\intbl    5.      Prevent diversion of motor vehicle traffic to the bicycle boulevard.\cell 5.      Diversion\cell\row

\par \tab The legislation also requires that the Administration update the Comprehensive Bikeways Facilities Plan to include a section that established 
\par \b Fiscal Impact: \b0  Two Hundred Thousand Dollars is provided from the Transportation Infrastructure Tax Fund (340) to engage a consultant to design and engineer a bike boulevard.
\par \b Comments:  \b0 Mountain Road is a minor arterial. The existing implementation strategies for bike boulevards only apply to local and major local streets. The City will have to develop a toolbox to create standards for installing a bike boulevard on an arterial street.
